action.new:
Exception raised when a nonblank, non-comment line is treated as a
   continuation of an option with no value. Continuation requires
   greater indentation than the preceding option and depends on the
   configured blank-line and comment handling. This applies when the
   *allow_no_value* constructor argument is ``True``. Subclass of
   :exc:`ParsingError`.

   The constructor arguments ``source``, ``lineno`` and ``line`` are
   available as attributes and preserved in ``args`` for copying and
   pickling. ``source`` identifies the input; :meth:`read_string`
   uses a supplied source name, defaulting to ``<string>``. ``lineno``
   is the one-based offending line number. ``line`` retains that raw
   line exactly, including a final newline only when present.
action.old:
Raised when an indented continuation line follows a valueless option
   (an option with no value, as permitted by ``allow_no_value=True``).
   This is a subclass of :exc:`!ParsingError`.

   The constructor takes three arguments: ``source`` (the name of the
   source being parsed, or ``'<string>'`` for string input), ``lineno``
   (the one-based line number of the offending continuation line), and
   ``line`` (the exact text of that line, including its trailing
   newline).  All three values are stored as attributes of the same
   name and are preserved in ``args`` for pickling and copying.

   .. attribute:: source

   .. attribute:: lineno

   .. attribute:: line

   .. versionadded:: 3.12
